full_name: Malika Zeghal | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Rita E. Hauser Fellow Harvard University
bio: Malika Zeghal is the Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal Professor in Contemporary Islamic Thought and Life at Harvard University’s Faculty of Arts and Sciences. She is a political scientist who studies the intersection of contemporary Islam and politics. She is particularly interested in Islamist movements and in the institutionalization of Islam in the Middle East, North Africa, and the West.
